"''I hate being a musician.|Lirin Car'n and Muftak|}} '''Lirin Car'n''' was a [[Bith]] [[Gender|male]] who was a backup [[kloo horn]] player and a member of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. The son of renowned [[kloo horn]] player [[Lirin D'avi]], he was a talented [[musician]] but nevertheless disliked playing professionally. He was with the Modal Nodes on [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]], playing at both [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] and [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Lirin Car'n was [[Reproduction|born]] the [[Gender|son]] of [[Lirin D'avi]], a renowned [[musician]] considered by many [[Bith]] to be the best [[kloo horn]] player that had ever lived. Car'n eventually followed in his [[Parent|father's]] footsteps, and after his father's [[death]], came into possession of his kloo horn. ===The Modal Nodes=== Car'n eventually joined the [[band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]], led by the eccentric [[Figrin D'an]]. However, Car'n grew to despise his bandleader as well as his bandmates, as well as the restless lifestyle of a musician. [[File:Modal_Nodes_02.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Other members of Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes performing]] D'an, who was considered insufferable because of his tendency to book gigs without the band's consent, secured them a gig on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Tatooine]], assuring them it would pay well and only last for a [[standard week]]. D'an, however, had not told them that he had a price on his head, and, having been found by [[Rodian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]], had sold the band into indentured servitude to pay off his debt. The job, which was actually for [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], lasted for over a [[Standard year|year]], causing further friction between the band and its leader. By [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} however, D'an secured the band's freedom, a feat accomplished by exposing Greedo's activities behind Jabba's back. They arrived in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]]; instead of making their way off-planet, however, D'an secured the band a gig playing at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. ===Mos Eisley=== {{Quote|As far as I'm concerned, the horn stopped belonging to Myo once Myo ceased to actually ''have'' the thing. It is, as they say, in the wind. And I want it back.|Lirin Car'n on his father's kloo horn|}} At some point, Car'n had fallen into debt with Greedo; desperate for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], he set out to sell his father's kloo horn in Mos Eisley. However, before he could do so, he became intoxicated and lost the horn to the [[Abyssin]] [[Myo]] in a card game. Unbeknownst to Car'n, Myo promptly became similarly intoxicated and lost it, the [[Talz]] [[Thief|pickpocket]] [[Muftak]] having stolen it. Now without his horn to sell to the Rodian loan shark, Car'n hired [[Sakiyan]] [[bounty]] hunter [[Djas Puhr]] to retrieve it. Though Puhr had also been hired to retrieve it by Myo, Car'n promised him a payout of two hundred credits in exchange for the kloo horn. [[File:Muftak_drinking.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Myo, Muftak, Lirin Car'n, and Djas Puhr at their table in the cantina]] Car'n was found by Greedo, accompanied by hired muscle, namely [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]]. Despite not having the [[Currency|money]], Greedo granted Car'n clemency, in part because of Car'n's pleas for mercy and also because of Greedo's mission to kill the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], who was also in Chalmun's [[Cantina]] at the [[time]]. Eventually, Puhr acquired the horn from an individual known as [[The Scrapper]], who had in turn acquired it from Muftak's companion [[Kabe]], having sold the item to pay off a loan to [[Ackmena]]. Car'n confronted the combined group of pickpockets, thieves, and scoundrels at a table at the cantina. In the heated conversation it became clear that much of the group's complicated caper stemmed from Solo's failure to deliver his cargo of narcotics to Muftak, but Puhr convinced the group to let the smuggler live, promising to pay off all the debts himself. Though Greedo's attempt to murder Solo went forward, this was hampered by the arrival of [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in the cantina, who, in an altercation, incapacitated Baba and Evazan. Without his henchmen, Greedo confronted Solo alone and was killed. With Car'n now debt-free, Puhr returned his kloo horn, defusing the situation. ==Behind the scenes== [[Doug Beswick]] portrayed Lirin Car'n.{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Lirin Car'n}} *{{StoryCite|story=Not for Nothing|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Kloo Horn Cantina Caper|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[Phineas and Ferb: Star Wars]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWE|locations|cantina|Mos Eisley Cantina}} {{Po}} *{{SWE|groups|talz|Talz}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' {{1stID|Lirin Car'n}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|78|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Entertainment Weekly's The Ultimate Guide to Han Solo]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: How Not to Get Eaten by Ewoks and Other Galactic Survival Skills]]'' {{Po}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}} {{Po}} *{{StoryCite|story=Star Tours (episode)|book=Wikipedia:Behind the Attraction|text=''Behind the Attraction''}} {{Video}} *{{GoS|Oddities}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ライリン・カーン |ka=ლირინ კარ'ნი |pl=Lirin Car'n}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Carn, Lirin}} [[Category:Bith]] [[Category:Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes members]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Musicians]]
